svg.title: Palco do Ritmo
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Palco do Ritmo.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached illustration ONLY as a STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: the same premium detailed pixel-art look, crisp small pixels, nuanced dithering, dimensional lighting and cozy Brazilian indie-adventure atmosphere. Retain the SAME Black teenage heroine: dark brown skin, short voluminous curly afro, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE wholly new finished VOICES challenge cover, replacing the whole setting, composition and action with the described scene. Panoramic landscape 20:9, around 1870x841, for a small 640x288 game-selection card. Rich but readable focal hierarchy, clear gameplay storytelling and strong silhouettes. Keep all primary action within the central 75 percent height. No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, HUD, borders or UI screenshots. No photorealism, smooth vector shapes or toy 3D. Challenge: Palco do Ritmo. An exuberant community concert at blue-hour dusk. Four clearly separated short lanes of glowing amber, lavender, teal and coral rhythm tiles lead from the foreground toward a small wooden stage. Floating square musical beats hover above the lanes without letters or numbers. The heroine stands in the lower middle tapping a drum-shaped controller pad in rhythm, seen at a lively three-quarter angle. On stage two Black community musicians play hand drums and a guitar; string lights, colorful fabric bunting and a few joyful audience silhouettes frame the performance. A cozy neighborhood square with flowering trees and tiled roofs behind the stage. Warm stage spotlights against deep teal and navy twilight, gold highlights, joyful motion and musical energy. Make the four-lane rhythm action instantly legible. No text, no portals, no giant electric guitars, no branded instruments."}
